_verification_needed: VERIFICATION NEEDED: this list was written WITHOUT a network check (from the builder's knowledge). It needs one verification pass against likumi.lv and the Cabinet working-day-transfer orders for 2026-2027 (WP6 / V1) before the pilot.
_about: Latvian public holidays used by get_slots and the works logic. Statutory days are cited from the law; anything not verified against an official source is marked assumption:true and is treated as NON-working (the safe side: Anna never offers a slot on a day the office may be closed).

law.title_lv: Par svētku, atceres un atzīmējamām dienām
law.title_en: Law on Holidays, Remembrance Days and Celebration Days
law.published: likumi.lv (official consolidated text); cited from the builder's knowledge, not re-fetched (no network access during the build)
law.scope: Lists the public holidays: 1 Jan; Good Friday, Easter Sunday and Easter Monday (Easter is computed in code); 1 May; 4 May; 23 and 24 Jun; 18 Nov; 24, 25, 26 and 31 Dec.

extra_days.source: assumption: weekend-shift rule (a holiday on a weekend moves the day off to the next working day); not verified
assumption: same weekend-shift rule; not verified

working_day_transfers.note: Cabinet of Ministers orders that move a working day to another date (for example a Saturday worked for a bridge day) are NOT known to the builder and are not applied. Check likumi.lv for the 2026 and 2027 orders before the pilot.

coverage.note: Statutory fixed days and Easter are computed for any year; extra_days only cover 2026-2027.
